SOURCE_ONLY_UNVERIFIED; no executable, compiler, import, AST, tests, lints, GPU/model/process/Git/cleanup performed.
Base immutable integrated WN0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035; current worktrees/old packets/reports remain unchanged. R262/R265 are source design references, not runtime backend/time/correctness proof.
Common private submit_grouped returns actual leaf event and backend identity plus logical G/maxrows/N/K geometry. Production void wrapper retains no-op empty handling and finish(stream,event) completion policy, with unchanged kernels, tile math and queues. Grouped selector now uses supplied queue device/context, not current Runtime compute device; global-device cached eligibility previously mismatched cross-device stream submission. Other use_xmx callers continue using compute queue. PerDevice eligibility remains per-device; supported Runtime owns one context per device, diagnostic uses exact same context. Different-context arbitrary supplied queues are not a supported contract.
New SYCL-only header and diagnostic API require Runtime exact context/device, profiling+in_order queue, queue_profiling aspect, exact bounded 16-group GU1280x2560 orDown2560x640, maxrows1..256, strideN*K. Validates host-accessible USM bounds origin/monotonic/pergroup max, operand USM context/device, null/alignment via existing xmx_gemm_ok. Caller owns immutable bounds and extents; allocation extent cannot be inferred from pointer API. No forced backend. Existing MMA forced/usable predicates preserved. Selected XMX queries executable EXACT GroupedKernel<128,256,3> before submission; exception/missing kernel means unavailable/FAILED with no fallback timing substitute. Existing generic GRF probe is not treated as exact grouped proof. DP4a/MMA selected event reported as their own identity. tile_m/n/pipeline0 for those means leaf-owned/unspecified physical geometry, not XMX tiles; logical geometry remains exact. No kernels recreated.
Diagnostic executable accepts one phase gu/down and one NT1/8/16/128/256 cell per process, no repeats/retry/grid internally. Main owns external finite wall/CPU/RSS/log/health/fault/normal closure. Profiling/in_order new queue same Runtime context/device and local async-error latch; production queue never gains profiling. Shared-USM immutable synthetic operands are deliberate diagnostic difference, not production residency equivalence. Each allocation checked below actual max and combined <=192MiB; maxGU weight100MiB. Small deterministic dyadic FP16 operands, 16 exact printed bounds incl empty/ragged experts and firstgroup exactmax, fullarray CPU independent actual-operand dot/reference and16 trailing canaries. Column-separable weights limit redundant reference products; this is not broad random model qualification or full pipeline parity. Tests both actual GU/down shapes across separate Main-owned cells.
Exact selected event wait_and_throw + queue wait_and_throw + async latch + complete status precede start/end profiling query; end>=start required. Event retained through query/free. Hostsubmit and submit-to-completion measured separately, including possible firstlaunch/exactbundle overhead; never a barrier duration. PASS printed only after full output check, successful final drain, async latch and freeing completed allocations. On failure drain required before free; failed drain _Exit fail-stop prevents releasing undrained state. No reset/retry/kill/device services. Runtime initialization may do its own setup; fresh external health needed, not claimed zeroGPU.
Correct R265 assumption: model prefill constexpr topk10, not8; 8K average160 over512 only hypothetical allGPU uniform estimate, never actual perexpert count. This fixture bounds are synthetic, not measured model route counts. No optimization implemented; no service-time, speed, correctness, sustained throughput, critical-path or production performance claim. Backend/profiling support remains unverified.
